questions.question: With in_channels=3, num_classes=3, and input shape (2,3,64,64), what shape does UNet return?
questions.explanation: The encoder downsamples and the decoder restores the spatial size; outc emits one logit map per class.

questions.question: Two adjacent cars share the same label in a semantic segmentation mask. What does the task represent?
options: Each car receives a unique instance ID
Both pixels are simply class car; the instances are not separated
The pixels become 3D point tracks
Only the nearest car is retained
questions.explanation: Semantic segmentation assigns a class to every pixel. Instance segmentation would distinguish car #1 from car #2.

questions.question: In Up.forward, why are the decoder tensor and skip tensor concatenated along the channel dimension?
options: Concatenation removes the spatial dimensions
It converts class indices into RGB colors
The decoder gains high-resolution encoder features before DoubleConv refines them
It ensures every channel has the same semantic label
questions.explanation: The skip connection preserves fine spatial detail lost during pooling, while the decoder supplies the upsampled context.

questions.question: What does dice_loss apply before comparing probabilities with one-hot targets?
options: Sigmoid independently over the batch dimension
An argmax that removes every non-winning class
A convolution with a 3x3 kernel
Softmax over the class dimension
questions.explanation: The function converts per-class logits to probabilities with F.softmax(dim=1), then computes class-wise overlap.

questions.question: If lam=1.0, what does combined_loss return as its scalar loss?
options: Cross-entropy plus one Dice loss
Cross-entropy multiplied by Dice loss
Only the IoU of class zero
The mean of raw logits
questions.explanation: The implementation returns ce + lam*dc, along with detached component values for logging.

questions.question: Why can iou_per_class return NaN for a class?
options: Its class index is always out of range
That class has zero pixels in both prediction and target, so its union is zero
IoU is computed from logits before argmax
The code divides by the number of training epochs
questions.explanation: The function explicitly returns NaN when union==0; the main loop converts such values to zero before averaging.
